character.name: Mikatsuki Runa
character.description: The in-universe Runa helps Sovia carry her voice into the audience's world. This profile describes her role in the story, not the real-world creator's biography.
character.identityNote: The real-world creator and in-universe Runa use the same stage name. Their profile IDs separate real-world biography from story facts. The +i marker classifies world of origin only; it does not establish whether this role is an avatar, self-insert, or separate fictional person.
quotes: So… which world do I belong to now?
character.biography: Ordinary classes, part-time work, meals, sleep, and a little singing. She also helps Sovia carry her voice into your world.
character.worldOrigin: Apparently the dimension where YouTube exists

relationships.description: The in-universe Runa and Sovia seem able to sense each other.
Runa met QI-7 in a game dungeon, and they became good friends afterward.
